product.title: Game Factory: Daily Duel
product.short_description: One shared browser challenge every day, rotating through five Game Factory contenders with a local streak and instant sharing.
product.description: Game Factory: Daily Duel is a zero-install HTML5 daily challenge built from the existing winner-search lineup: Ring Pins, Circuit Flow, Gravity Flip, Bridge Snap, and Cluster Collapse. Everyone receives the same contender on the same UTC day. Players protect a local streak, replay only if the mechanic earns another run, and share the same daily duel with a friend. The product adds no new standalone mechanic; it is designed to concentrate return traffic and reveal which existing game earns stronger replay and daily-return behavior.
product.controls: Touch, mouse, or the controls shown inside the selected daily contender.
